strat: H first / M1-R1 NW / M2-R2 NE; lines T-M-R-H

steps.title: Stack in the first tower
steps.rule: Three towers appear one at a time on the south, north-west and north-east spots. Treat the first one as south: the whole party stacks inside it.

steps.title: Healers soak, tanks take the first wing
steps.cue: Wings Dark and Light cast starts
steps.rule: H1 and H2 stay in the first tower. M1 and R1 wait just outside it on its clockwise side, M2 and R2 on its counter-clockwise side, each pair next to the tower it takes next.

MainTank.rule: Take the first cleave on an empty tower spot so it sweeps the far third, away from the party: the M1/R1 tower when her right wing glows dark first, the M2/R2 tower when her left wing glows light first.

OffTank.rule: Bait the first tether. Dark hits the nearest player: hug Pandora on the first tower's side. Light hits the farthest: run out past the first tower on the M2/R2 side.

steps.title: Tanks swap, DPS take their towers
steps.rule: M1 and R1 move into the next tower clockwise, M2 and R2 into the next one counter-clockwise; they go off in the order they lit up. H1 and H2 wait on the far side of Pandora, opposite the first tower.

MainTank.rule: Bait the second tether, the other colour: for dark hug Pandora on the side away from the first tower, for light run far out opposite the first tower.

OffTank.rule: Provoke and take the second cleave next to the old first tower spot, so it sweeps the empty first third: on the M1/R1 side when dark went first, on the M2/R2 side when light went first.

steps.title: Set up for Polarizing Strikes
steps.rule: West group (MT, H1, M1, R1) goes 6m out south-west of Pandora, east group (OT, H2, M2, R2) 6m out south-east.

MainTank.rule: Stand just north of Pandora so she faces north before Polarizing Strikes locks her facing.

OffTank.rule: Wait with the MT just north of Pandora, then bait your group's first line.

steps.title: Tanks bait the first lines
steps.rule: Each round a light line hits the closest player on Pandora's left (west) and a dark line the closest on her right (east), and each is a stack. Tanks bait first: MT 4m out south-west, OT 4m out south-east, each group 6m out right behind its tank.

steps.title: Dodge the echo
steps.rule: Each line explodes again where it went 2s later. Right after the hit everyone slips into the gap straight south, between the two lines; the pair that just baited moves to the other group's half of the gap and the next pair moves to the front.

steps.title: Next pair baits
steps.rule: Back out to the diagonals: the next pair in the order tanks, melee, ranged, healers steps to 4m with the rest 6m behind. Anyone who has already taken a line now stands on the other diagonal, so their next hit is the other colour.
